own_solution.law: Closed-open pipe fundamental f = c/(4 L_eff) with c proportional to sqrt(T); L_eff fixed by tuning, so f(T) = f0 sqrt(T/T1); beat = |f(T) - f_fork|
assumptions: L_eff and fork frequency independent of temperature

TC352.regime: displacement amplitude much smaller than the wavelength (about 0.78 m), linear acoustics in which pitch is independent of amplitude

T096C.regime: displacement amplitude much smaller than the wavelength, linear regime

notes: sqrt(301/288) = sqrt(1.045139) = 1.022320; pipe at 301 K: 449.821 Hz; beat 9.821 Hz (c0 and T0 cancel). With fork raised by 62 Hz before tuning (502 Hz): pipe tuned to 502 Hz at 288 K, 513.205 Hz at 301 K, beat 11.205 Hz. End correction: L_eff = L + e is fixed by the tuning condition c(288)/(4 L_eff) = f_fork, so e cancels (C). Amplitude 18 um is in the linear regime (K); arguably it could be classed C or D-like since it enters no relation, but it belongs to the system. Guitar and earlier-experiment sentences are D. T54B8 and T41CC carry no number (numeral-free versions).
